title: Call Service
text: Call service in ROS 2 network, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Source} sets Source for specifying service name Select from ROS network; {Name} sets the service name character vector, {Type} sets the service type character vector, {Connection timeout} sets the timeout for service server connection, {Show ErrorCode output port} enables error code output port, {History} sets the mode of storing requests in the queue Keep, {Depth} sets the size of the request queue, {Reliability} sets the delivery guarantee, {Durability} sets the persistence of requests, {Deadline} sets the maximum amount of time allowed between sending service request and receiving response, {Lifespan} sets the length of time a service request is considered valid, {Liveliness} sets the level of liveliness reporting provided by the block and expected from service server and {Lease Duration} sets the maximum amount of time before which connected service server has to assert liveliness. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error conditions for service call integer

params.values: Source for specifying service name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.values: Timeout for service server connection 5 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.values: Maximum amount of time before which connected service server has to assert liveliness Inf (default) | positive scalar
